_note: Relics (docs/plans/design/relics/, phase 5c step 5a; docs/plans/phases/rebuild-phase5c-combos.md, section 10): team-wide, no downsides, in tiers (common, rare, epic, legendary, boss). The whole pool: 44 from step 5a, 20 from 5b, 11 from 5c-1, 11 from 5c-2, and the 3 bond relics from 5d (tier bond: free, only in shops once their duo bond is on). Texts keep numbers out (the UI adds them from the mod and run rules). Icons reuse the placeholder glyphs until the art rehaul. Numbers are placeholders.
name: Whetstone of the Fallen
flavor: Worn hollow by blades that didn't come back.
text: Every hero hits harder.

name: Bloodstone
flavor: It drinks the light around it.
text: Every hero's ATK rises.

name: Iron Filings
flavor: A pouch of what was left of a shield wall.
text: Every hero's DEF rises.

name: Warden's Chain
flavor: Each link was someone's oath.
text: Every hero's DEF rises.

name: Hearthstone Shard
flavor: Still warm from a hearth that isn't there.
text: Every hero's max HP rises.

name: Quickened Pulse
flavor: It beats a little faster than you'd like.
text: Every hero attacks faster.

name: Bone Dice
flavor: They always land the way the rift wants.
text: Every hero crits more often.

name: Rift Candle
flavor: It burns down, never out.
text: Heroes with mana fill their bars faster.

name: Brand of Guilt
flavor: It knows who struck first.
